apps.name: AutoClick Pro: Macro Recorder & Input Automation
apps.short_description: An auto clicker, macro recorder and scripting tool for Windows, SteamOS and Linux that can see the screen. Wait for an image, click it wherever it appears, or run a profile the moment it shows up, and launch it all from a mouse button, key or controller.

apps.name: GameTechBench
apps.short_description: A high-performance benchmark powered by Unreal Engine 5 to measure your GPU's power in real-world gaming conditions and in offline cinematic rendering.

apps.name: HexScrawl
apps.short_description: HexScrawl is a collaborative hex-map cartography program for running and playing hex crawl TTRPG campaigns and Westmarches-style games.

apps.name: picoCAD 2
apps.short_description: picoCAD 2  is a 3D modelling tool that lets you make low poly models with a unique aesthetic, A fun, easy, and accessible 3D modeller focusing on the bare essentials.

apps.name: Soundpad
apps.short_description: Play sounds in voice chats in high digital quality. Add sounds or music to your microphone signal so others will hear it, too.

apps.name: VTube Studio
apps.short_description: VTube Studio is all you'll ever need to become a Live2D VTuber, with innovative features such as pinning props to your model and many more still to come.

apps.name: Don't Die! You got 1 Life! Playtest
Fate of Fire: Kyvedy Guardiah Playtest
Astral Industrial Complex Demo
apps.short_description: A space automation game with rogue lite elements. Take the role of a rogue defense drone building up a mining and defense industry in the far reaches of space.

apps.name: Ball Bugz Demo
apps.short_description: Try the first three missions of Ball Bugz, an incremental defense game about bouncing balls and bug swarms. Throw stones, place a Core Ball, unlock a Stone Cannon and earn Research to upgrade your setup between attempts.

apps.name: Clown Town Demo
apps.short_description: Clown Town is an immersive horror job simulation game. Make your way through a massive abandoned circus doing whatever needs done. But the warehouse is filled with psychotic clowns and demonic entities. Intensity amplifies as you make it deeper into the levels. Time to get to work.

apps.name: Daydream Drifters Demo
apps.short_description: A roguelike stealth horror where dungeons, enemies, and items are procedurally generated. With dynamic events over time and changing weather, hide from diverse foes—or prepare to fight. Explore 3 seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream.

apps.name: Deeplanders Demo
apps.short_description: DEEPLANDERS is a minimalist construction puzzle game about populating the depths and bringing light into them. Build cozy underground cities and find the perfect place for each Deeplander to live in harmony.

apps.name: Design My Drink! Demo
apps.short_description: Design drinks for customers, in order to save your café from being demolished! Unlock more flavors and decorations and make even greater and more challenging designs.

apps.name: Doggy Don't Care Demo
apps.short_description: Unleash adorable chaos, solve puzzles, and leave your mark (literally!) as a mischievous dog left at home alone.

apps.name: Eternal Decay Souls Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a dark world filled with cursed creatures, solve ancient puzzles, and confront powerful bosses on a journey where each relic discovered reveals the secrets of eternal decay.

apps.name: Half Sword Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to Half Sword Demo, an immersive, physics-based medieval combat simulator that lets you fight brutal tournaments in 15th-century Europe. You can wield your weapon with precision using your mouse, feeling the intensity of each clash as you ascend the ranks to face formidable opponents.

apps.name: Idle Armada Demo
apps.short_description: Deep idle game with NO ads, NO in-app-purchases. Watch your fleet battle automatically. Collect items and upgrade your buildings and fleet to reach progressively higher levels!

apps.name: Internet Provider 98 Demo
apps.short_description: Bring the world online in an idle incremental game with a retro ’90s desktop aesthetic. Send data packets, upgrade your hardware, automate your network, and speed up research with an icon-matching minigame. Grow from your first customers to a global internet provider.

apps.name: marblebuilds Demo
apps.short_description: Not your ordinary marble physics sandbox. Watch the simulation play out, or control the marbles yourself. Snap blocks to an infinite grid to build anything you can imagine: automated music tracks, functional calculators, precision platformer courses, pinball machines, and playable minigames.

apps.name: Paradis Demo
apps.short_description: Play the whole first circuit of Paradis for free: an adult card roguelike where every woman in your deck scores by what she wears, how she poses and where she is. Chain combos, outplay the Basement's judges, beat Kitty in the Grand Contest, then see how far endless mode takes you.

apps.name: Pseudo-Psy Play PARTI
apps.short_description: A 21st Century Noir Horror Game. Race against time to collect puzzle pieces and unlock mysterious texture pages in this eccentric blend of a side-scrolling shooter and a point-and-click adventure. Are you ready, Joseph?

apps.name: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first three chapters of Deja Damnation. A mandatory corporate workshop begins repeating after a participant disappears. Your choices carry forward, coworkers remember your behavior, and the System continues its assessment.

apps.name: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up Demo
Scarlet's Last Call Demo
apps.short_description: Scarlet's Last Call is a 2.5D cyberpunk beat 'em up. By night she runs a neon bar; by dawn she hunts bounties. Play as deadly femme fatale Scarlet in her sexy outfits and tear through cyber-gangs, hounds, and bosses with brutal combos and cinematic finishers. Every contract could be her last call.

apps.name: Soul Gathering Demo
apps.short_description: Every card is both your sword and your shield—but each use wears it down until it crumbles to nothing. Seven classes, a deck that decays, and enemies hungry for souls. Reach the heart of a collapsing world with whatever cards you have left. A roguelike deck-building card battler.

apps.name: Tears of the Maker Demo
apps.short_description: Tears of the Maker is a Pachinko-Inspired roguelite deck builder. Tears flow to the chambers to determine who takes damage. Use your cards to manipulate various aspects of the game in order to change your fate.

apps.name: TowerOf100Heroes Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Tower of 100 Heroes. Mow down endless hordes in this auto-attack survivors-like roguelite and free the heroes sealed in the Witch's orb. Climb the first 30 floors across 3 regions, defeat 6 bosses, unlock 30 heroes, awaken skills and farm Diablo-style loot.

apps.name: Vampolitics: Vassal of the Void Demo
apps.short_description: Rule a vampire coven from your throne in deep space. Judge petitioners, manage blood and gold, and face a war you didn't choose. Reign well, or reign briefly.

apps.name: Very Disco, Disco Very! Demo
apps.short_description: Everyone locks in moves at once, then the simulation takes over. A dense, chaotic programming game for 1 to 8 players where pushes, cards, and chain reactions ensure nothing goes as intended.

apps.name: Warlords of Archaios Online Demo
apps.short_description: Command the Kingdoms in this free fantasy RTS demo. Build your base, gather resources, lead warlords, and battle across Verduran in single-player skirmishes, Steam online multiplayer, or LAN. Try different strategies and share your feedback.

apps.name: Where Are The Alices? Demo
apps.short_description: Detect lies and break the denizens of Wonderland in this noir thriller. As Detective Juno, confront contradictions within the corrupt WoodHale under a ticking clock. Manage your trauma and extract confessions. Are you a good person?

apps.name: Wirehawk Demo
apps.short_description: Wirehawk is a neon vector shmup in the spirit of 80s arcade classics. Play it your way: razor-sharp mouse control, or a dedicated controller mode rebalanced for the stick. Blast asteroids and alien waves, dodge bullet storms, slow time with stasis. Autofire always on.

apps.name: Worlds Upon The Wind Demo
apps.short_description: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

apps.name: Coloring Pixels - Realistic Pack
apps.short_description: Using a photo-realistic art style, this book is great for making images with some amazing life-like results!

apps.name: Dead by Daylight - Steady Pulse
apps.short_description: Dead by Daylight’s Steady Pulse includes a new Survivor, Orela Rose onto the scene. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Cosmetic: Black and White Blazer.

apps.name: Desktop Halfpipe - Halfpipe Drive-in
apps.short_description: A roadside lot for Desktop Halfpipe. Skate past the diner, serve the cars, and leave a movie running, with the halfpipe small in the distance.

apps.name: DOA5LR Tropical Paradise Costume & Movie Set
apps.short_description:
See the ladies of DOA soak up some sun in 54 swimsuits and 16 movies.

*You must have the latest update installed before using this content.

©2015 Valve Corporation. Steam and the Steam logo are trademarks and/or registered trademarks of Valve Corporation in the U.S. and/or other countries.

apps.name: DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT - DAIMA - Adventure Through The Demon Realm PART 1
apps.short_description: Part 1 of an additional story set in the world of the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series: DAIMA: Adventure Through The Demon Realm.

apps.name: DragonSword : Awakening - Costume : Minstrel of the Black Stage
apps.short_description: Purchasing this content lets you obtain "Minstrel of the Black Stage" which adorns Othello's outfit, and "Lute of the Hidden Eve" which adorns the weapon's appearance.

apps.name: DragonSword : Awakening - Costume : Royal Ceremonial Knight Uniform
apps.short_description: Purchasing this content lets you obtain "Royal Ceremonial Knight Uniform" which adorns Reina's outfit, and "Royal Ceremonial Sword" which adorns the weapon's appearance.

apps.name: DragonSword : Awakening - Costume : Wild Strawberry Waitress
apps.short_description: Purchasing this content lets you obtain "Wild Strawberry Waitress," which adorns Dana's outfit, and "Sweet Service," which adorns the weapon's appearance.

apps.name: Dungeon Rampage - DLC: Santa Ranger Skin
apps.short_description: From roof top to roof top, to taverns and dungeons.  This Ranger is tired of gifting, and looking for enemies to bludgeon!

apps.name: Dungeon Rampage - DLC: Shadow Wolf Pet
apps.short_description: A wolf born of living shadow. Attacks with a shadow-shifting teleport attack!

apps.name: Dungeon Rampage - DLC: Venom Dragon Pet
apps.short_description: A dragon with a toxic temper. Shoots blasts of venom, poisoning groups of enemies!

apps.name: Far Cry New Dawn - HD Textures Pack
apps.short_description: The Ultra-HD texture pack will upgrade some of the most common textures in the game, to a new level of visual fidelity, such as characters and weapons.

apps.name: Guild Wars 2® Visions of Eternity™ Expansion
apps.short_description: Train new elite specializations, master new mount abilities, face deadly encounters, and more as you explore the magic-warped island of Castora.

apps.name: Lightyear Frontier - Pioneer's Bundle
apps.short_description: Lightyear Frontier is a peaceful open-world farming adventure on a planet at the far edge of the galaxy. Climb into your versatile mech and start your new home on a distant planet with up to 3 friends as you farm alien crops, build your own homestead, and explore the untamed wilderness of the world.

apps.name: MobMate Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: A one-time purchase providing access to validated MobMate updates between Free milestone releases. These updates may later be included in Free. Vulkan Acceleration Pack and future major DLC are not included.

apps.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire Story DLC
apps.short_description: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire Story DLC

apps.name: POSTAL 2: Paradise Lost
apps.short_description: Paradise Lost is a full-fledged expansion pack for POSTAL 2 continuing the saga of the POSTAL series. Join the Dude as he ventures back into his former hometown embarking on a quest to find his lost dog.

apps.name: PowerWash Simulator 2 - STAR WARS Pack
apps.short_description: Step into the Star Wars™ galaxy as P0-W2, a humble Class Five cleaning droid, turned filth-fighting rebel!  Wield the jet-force of high-pressure water to blast away imperial scum from six iconic original trilogy locations and ships in this epic dirt-busting saga.

apps.name: Sally Face - Season Pass
apps.short_description: Sally Face Episodes 2 - 5. Plus the Sally Face Original Soundtrack.

apps.name: Stronghold HD - USA Campaign Map Skin
apps.short_description: Revisit the original Stronghold with this cosmetic DLC! It's 1492 and The Wolf has somehow both lived for several hundred years and made it to the land of opportunity! Medieval England can wait, because it's up to you to journey east and make America great again.

apps.name: SUPER ROBOT WARS Y - Anniversary Expansion Pack
apps.short_description: Anniversary Expansion Pack includes the following content: 5 Playable Units, 33 Area Missions, 12 New Weapons, 1 Assist Crew Member, and 1 Bonus Mission.

apps.name: Text Battle Royale - Supporter's Pack
apps.short_description: A Supporter's Pack for Text Battle Royale containing 3 animated sprays, 3 original kill signatures and 3 special taunts voice-acted by the devs (no comment).

apps.name: Tropico 6 - Caribbean Skies
apps.short_description: The beloved dicta…uh, leader El Presidente sets out to conquer the Caribbean Skies! The biggest DLC for Tropico 6 to date takes the fun to new altitudes with - drones.

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Mission 1 - Terror Lab
apps.short_description: The Führer has been defeated, but THE DEAD STILL RISE. Infiltrate a mysterious laboratory, tear your way through zombified researchers and solve the mystery of the zombie scourge!

apps.name: 66: Dinosaur Survival
apps.short_description: 66 is a brutal multiplayer dinosaur survival game where you hunt, grow, hide, migrate, and fight your way through a prehistoric ecosystem where every mistake can be fatal.

apps.name: Airspace Master
apps.short_description: Control both skies and ground in a complete ATC experience. Manage arrivals, departures, and taxi operations while maintaining Operational Integrity. Dynamic weather, a day/night cycle, multiple airports, and unique challenges.

apps.name: Anomaly Quest
apps.short_description:
RTS - Tower Defense - MOBA - Hybrid in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by anomalies.

Build a base. Defend your perimeter. Defeat your opponents.

apps.name: Appulse
apps.short_description: A thrilling top-down shooter inspired by pinball mechanics. Master your weapon and use the recoil to control your ball, while protecting your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment, polish your skills, and win the war!

apps.name: Atom By Atom
apps.short_description: Build a factory around a black hole. Extract elements, route atoms through Matter Tubes, bond them using valence-driven chemistry, and scale precise molecular production lines atom by atom.

apps.name: Beast Snap
apps.short_description: Build a deck from 500+ hand-painted monster cards across nine planets, pick a Boss, and battle on a living board. Outsmart rival Bosses with spells, traps and Places, then open booster packs and upgrade your favorite cards to shiny Holo and Prism.

apps.name: Beneath the Record
apps.short_description: Compare statements and evidence in old case files to uncover contradictions. Arrange character and object tokens across locations and time periods to reconstruct each case and reveal the truth buried beneath the records.

apps.name: Beyond The Abandoned
apps.short_description: Climb through the shifting realms of your mind, confronting hazards, enemies, and risky decisions on your ascent to regain consciousness.

apps.name: BLACK RELAY
apps.short_description: BLACK RELAY is a short-form sci-fi horror experience set on a remote planet trapped in perpetual darkness. Restore the relay network, locate the missing research crew, and watch your back as you trek your way through the dark terrain while completing mission objectives.

apps.name: Blue Dimension: Save the Game
apps.short_description: Machines are stealing the world's last PCs. Fight through a neon labyrinth, find the key and SAVE THE GAME before it's gone. Die, and you don't restart: you become your drone and fly back to a revive PC. Pierce enemy lines with a laser sniper and rocket-jump through the Blue Dimension.

apps.name: Cargocracy: Space Warfare and Trade
apps.short_description: Run a spacefaring company from a strip on your desktop or play full screen. Trade, mine, salvage or raid in a living galaxy while you work: your captains haul, fight and explore on your orders. Grow from one ship to colonies and a faction of your own.

apps.name: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
apps.short_description: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

apps.name: Christmas Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
apps.short_description: Find 100 hidden cats across 10 festive Christmas scenes! Search carefully, use hints wisely, avoid wrong clicks, and race against time. Discover every cat, unlock achievements, and claim your place on the global leaderboard!

apps.name: CityGod Alice：城隍愛麗絲
apps.short_description:
Cursed with only a year left to live,
serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

apps.name: Coin Maker Simulator
apps.short_description: Enjoy the crafting process in this immersive, relaxing simulator about making money, literally. You've been locked in a dungeon, and your only way to freedom is to craft coins for the King!

apps.name: COLLAPSE MACHINE 3D
apps.short_description: In COLLAPSE MACHINE - scavenge, raid, and survive a super-magnetic wasteland in co-op PvE. Hoard tesla-punk tech, mine voxel terrain, run a mobile vehicle base through shifting seasons, intercept rivals, and siege their factories

apps.name: Compacted
apps.short_description: A slot machine roguelite where every spin is a fight for survival. Upgrade five symbols, choose run changing items, trigger jackpots, and repay escalating debts before the walls crush you.

apps.name: Cops N' Zombies
apps.short_description: A horror social deduction game where you and your friends take on the roles of police officers on a critical mission. But there is a zombie among you that can transform at will. Can you trust your friends?

apps.name: Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror
apps.short_description: Run a cozy little soup shop haunted by unsettling stories. In Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror, uncover hidden mysteries and unlock every secret recipe. Serve the right soup from the Super Soup 2000.

apps.name: Cozy Karaoke Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build the cosiest karaoke bar in town! Design rooms, hire staff, serve bubble tea and pizza, and keep every singer smiling. Win the City Karaoke Championship, then expand from a little street-corner bar to a mall and a rooftop lounge above the city lights.

apps.name: Cruise Control
apps.short_description: It's time to set sail! Manage a cruise liner fleet, build entertainment and relaxation facilities, and tend to your guests needs at every turn. Work fast to solve problems, earn rewards, and ensure smooth sailing! Are you ready to turn on Cruise Control?

apps.name: Cyyer
apps.short_description: Live in a vibrant pixel-art city where NPCs have real lives, unique routines, and evolving relationships. Explore, play minigames, complete missions, and uncover hidden secrets in this open-world multiplayer experience!

apps.name: Daedalia
apps.short_description: A Greek labyrinth rebuilt every game. Find the key, the Golden Fleece and the ichor before the others do — while the Minotaur hunts the corridors and the Medusa petrifies on sight. Die, and come back as a Shade to possess them

apps.name: Damage Numbers Go Brr!
apps.short_description: Damage Numbers Go Brr! is a chill incremental auto battler. Watch small numbers turn into absurdly huge numbers as you defeat enemies, get stronger, and vibe to the music while damage numbers fill your screen.

apps.name: Das Hexencafé am Zürichsee: Der letzte Eintrag
apps.short_description: An atmospheric fantasy visual novel set on Lake Zurich. Make meaningful choices, uncover the mystery of the final entry, and guide Liva through a story with multiple endings.

apps.name: Days After
apps.short_description: Scavenge a dying city, build your shelter, and craft weapons to survive the zombie apocalypse. Level up your hero, tame a loyal companion, and fight off raiders, wild beasts, and hordes of the infected in this open-world survival RPG.

apps.name: DeadFront
apps.short_description: DeadFront is a 1-to-4 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

apps.name: DEATHKILL
apps.short_description: With reality itself rupturing, Cael, prisoner of an unnamed cult, escapes his captors. Unmake everything.

apps.name: DIAGNOSIS
apps.short_description: First-person horror game where mimicking creatures hide among ordinary wildlife. Study animal behavior and spot anomalies before you shoot. Sell meat and hides, upgrade your gear, and retreat to your cabin when you become the prey.

apps.name: Dice Sort Together: Arcane Hall
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person tidy up and organizing simulator where you sort 4,400+ fantasy dice and tabletop pieces. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players, restore the Arcane Hall's 9 departments through relaxing, satisfying ASMR dice sounds and magic skills - no time limit.

apps.name: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War
apps.short_description: Hold a WW1 trench against an endless, escalating horde. Build a squad from the cards luck deals you, manage your requisition, then choose your moment to go over the top. A grim, darkly funny real-time roguelike — branching campaign, deep upgrades, and a forever-Endless mode.

apps.name: Disco Ball Simulator 2000
apps.short_description:
You owe 1 million $ and all you have is a disco ball!
A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night with light effects.
Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!

apps.name: Dominus Gladiatus
apps.short_description: Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly tournament against rival Domini.

apps.name: DROWNSCROLL
apps.short_description:
You argue about a shitty movie, visit your father, lose your job, have a beer, and somehow end up pulled back into a conversation you can't quite walk away from. Somewhere in between, the sea appears.

DROWNSCROLL is a short narrative story, about 45 minutes long.

apps.name: Echograph
apps.short_description: photograph ghosts, crack environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and unravel the mystery behind a generational family curse in this classic survival horror experience.

apps.name: Ender Inspector
apps.short_description: Power, women, and intrigue! Step into the shoes of a young inspector. Check documents, climb the career ladder, and pursue romances. Upgrade your workspace and make decisions that will shape the nation's destiny.

apps.name: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana
apps.short_description: A psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect that makes demons burst out of your screen. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, senses your fear. Forget predictable jumpscares.

apps.name: Fairlight 1&2
apps.short_description: The two hit games Fairlight I and II now as a single game updated for play on Windows/STEAM! The Fairlight games are famous for being award winning 3D adventure games with numerous puzzles to solve. Navigate the 3D world of castles and woodlands to find secret passages and magical objects.

apps.name: Fate of Persephone
apps.short_description: Defy death and challenge fate in a story-driven, first-person fantasy RPG inspired by classic 1990s dungeon crawlers. Explore a handcrafted world, master powerful magic, uncover ancient mysteries, and make decisions with lasting consequences. Your choices will shape your journey.

apps.name: Flock Off
apps.short_description: Optimize your flock by converting chickens colors, upgrading your coop, selecting flock abilities and even merging chickens to make them fancier! Travel all the way across Cluckshire to different contests, win contests to earn gold and keep building your chicken empire!

apps.name: Fox Stamps
apps.short_description: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

apps.name: Fragment Collapse
apps.short_description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

apps.name: From The Bunker
apps.short_description: After a devastating outbreak destroys a quiet southern town, lead a small group of survivors sheltering in an abandoned bunker. Build your refuge, manage relationships and morale, and make difficult choices that determine who lives and who dies.

apps.name: Gauntleteer
apps.short_description: Blast through the world of Aurelia as Kirborbie! Meet colorful characters and face 2D platformer skill-heavy bullet-hell battles. The RPG where every enemy is a boss!

apps.name: GIMMIKO
apps.short_description: Demons from the collective subconcious are leaking into reality. Save the world from the curse of the Jabberwock in this wacky dicebuilding twinstick action roguelite!

apps.name: Green Guy Goes Grappling
apps.short_description: Green Guy Goes Grappling is a fast-paced 2D platformer where Green Guy has to save the universe!

apps.name: Hellmouth
apps.short_description: Hellmouth is a bullet hell top-down shooter that drops you right in the middle of post-industrial hell. Blast through hordes of demons, create unique upgrades, and hopefully escape?!

apps.name: HINO
apps.short_description: Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and the white Monimoni Skeleton journey through a world of darkness in this 2D dark fantasy game. Having lost her memory, Hino seeks a safe haven in a land overrun by monsters, uncovering the truth of the dark world as she travels.

apps.name: HUMAN, 39.99
apps.short_description: Run a little shop that sells humans. Circle them to catch them, stock the shelves, keep the monsters queuing, and pour the profits into increasingly unreasonable upgrades. Short, snappy, and made to be finished, not grinded.

apps.name: Interstellar Inn
apps.short_description: Interstellar Inn is a 2D hotel building and management sim in space.

apps.name: Is This Reversi?
apps.short_description: Is This Reversi? is a Reversi tabletop sandbox where you can freely use the board and pieces. Place, move, flip, and remove pieces without the system enforcing legal moves, turns, or the end of the game, and play by your own rules.

apps.name: Just Farm
apps.short_description: Farming games can be complicated. This one isn’t. No empire to manage, no endless chores, no agricultural career waiting for you. Just relax, get in the tractor, and farm.

apps.name: LAMINA BRUISE
apps.short_description:
LAMINA BRUISE is a narrative-driven, first-person adventure set in a surreal sci-fi world. 
A tense yet meditative experience, paced by thoughtful puzzles.

apps.name: LASTWORLD
apps.short_description: LASTWORLD™  (Early Access) is an old-school inspired RTS, fast-paced, chaotic voxel fusion. Built  for multiplayer and competitive play. Unlock generals, skins, and items.  Build your own unique playstyle to wreak havoc on the battlefield!

apps.name: Layered Loop层叠环道
apps.short_description: Draft modules, stack your defenses, and keep firepower supplied as heroes travel the loop. Every new layer changes your build.

apps.name: Librarian of Aquademia : The Forbidden Grimoire
apps.short_description: An auto-2D side-scroller shoot'em up game that aims to be beginner-friendly for someone who has never experienced a shoot'em up bullet hell game before.

apps.name: Minesleeper
apps.short_description: You wake up in a distant part of the universe 27.000 years after being deployed on an urgent mission to save humanity from extinction. A minesweeper gets a dangerous makeover in this hexagonal roguelite. Outsmart devious puzzles, bend the odds, and turn failures into triumph.

apps.name: Miracle Karts
apps.short_description: Experience the thrills of a career in karting millimeters from the ripping pavement!

apps.name: Nederfall
apps.short_description: The Netherlands has fallen. Lead your survivors on scavenging trips through the ruins, find resources, recruit more survivors, and come home to a camp to take care for. Survivors cook, craft, and train on their own. Every item you bring back makes your camp grow stronger.

apps.name: Neldoaria
apps.short_description: A dying land, buried in ash. Seek Neldoaria beyond the desert. Summon souls bound by their names onto a 3×3 grid in this roguelite deckbuilder where cards shape the battlefield. 7 days. Day and night. How you spend your time and choices, and how it ends, is up to luck and to you.

apps.name: Night Ops: Undead
apps.short_description: Top-down zombie survival shooter for one to six players. Board the windows, spend your points on a better gun or the next door, and keep the squad standing. Fight through the campaign from a helicopter crash to extraction, or chase a record in Waves, Overrun and Infection.

apps.name: Nutty Dungeons
apps.short_description: Bold & Co. needs YOU for the Dungeon Design Initiative! Use 50+ cartoony parts to create your own action-platforming challenges in the Dungeon Maker — or grab your sword and shield and test dungeons uploaded by kobolds all over the world.

apps.name: Oddlay
apps.short_description: Flip the grid with overlapping pieces where placement matters. Take your time with this relaxing puzzle game as the challenge grows. Can you beat the Oddlay?

apps.name: One More Town
apps.short_description: Found a country anywhere on the real Earth in 1960, in one world shared by every player. Claim land, build farms, mines and factories, trade on the world exchange and grow your own brands. In the war world, march armies across real borders, where one nuke can end the season.

apps.name: Overspin
apps.short_description: Crack the whip over convicts who push a giant millstone to power the Company. Meet a quota that rises every midnight, keep your prisoners fed and alive, upgrade everything, smuggle contraband and dig a tunnel under the beds. A darkly comic active idle game with roguelite progression.

apps.name: Passage Zero
apps.short_description: A short psychological horror experience that asks one question: are you paying attention, or just doing what you were trained to?

apps.name: Patternbook
apps.short_description: Draw houses by hand at a drafting table. Clients write to you with the house they want. Draw every line, show them the drawing, and see it built. Later, a photograph comes of the house, lived in. Or draw your own dream house.

apps.name: Plush Time
apps.short_description: Plush Time is a 1-6 player online and local multiplayer party game where cuddly meets chaos! Customize your adorable plush, then throw down with friends or AI in a wild board game packed with ridiculous minigames guaranteed to wreck friendships and spark hilarious mayhem.

apps.name: ROBOT DRAFT: LAST HUMAN
apps.short_description: A first-person sci-fi escape adventure. Freeze robots, ignite fuel, and throw objects at enemies while solving escape-room puzzles. In the full game, build and playtest your own rooms, then share them as level files.

apps.name: Rogue Balls
apps.short_description:
Rogue Balls is a 3d top-down bullet-hell game in which enemies will chase you or attack you from a distance.
 Use your projectiles to brutally touch them to death while enjoying my banger EDM soundtrack.
 Become more powerful with every level-up, acquire Legendary items and epic cosmetics :)

apps.name: Rogue Lite
apps.short_description: Grab a weapon, pick a hero and dive in. A fast 2D action roguelite where every run builds a different hero – stack wild relics and spells, survive deadly rooms, topple huge bosses, and come back stronger every time you fall.

apps.name: Saber World League VR
apps.short_description: Saber World League VR is a physics-based 1v1 sword-fighting duel game for VR. Battle online in ranked PvP, challenge friends with a match code, or practice in the sandbox. Choose your weapon — sword, spear, knife or others — and customize your robot avatar to fight as.

apps.name: Self Recurse
apps.short_description:
Self Recurse blends card-battling and permanent progression. Delve into branching simulations with cards, dice, spellbooks, and artifacts to best your foes. 
Choose a theme to determine which rewards appear and shape evolving builds with every run.

apps.name: Sex Sky Marshal
apps.short_description: NY to London. A hidden bomb. Just 30 minutes. Play as a Sky Marshal, follow sound clues, find tools, and keep passengers calm—panic speeds up the clock. Face provocative demands every 10 minutes in a replayable adult thriller where every second counts.

apps.name: Shelf Stable
apps.short_description: Helix Dynamics sold the world a miracle product labeled Shelf Stable. It wasn't. Horde-scale tower defense: Hold Checkpoint Voss against tens of thousands of infected hosts, research heavier hardware, and come back until nothing is left walking.

apps.name: SONANCE
apps.short_description: Dive into your 'self' in SONANCE! A game about consciousness in a world that has lost it. Offering both Bullet Hell and Deckbuilder JRPG mechanics. Explore a modern, dystopian world. SHATTER or PURIFY those with no thought left. Choose what it means to be 'sentient', with fully human-made pixel art!

apps.name: Sonorous | Deep Down Below
apps.short_description: SONOROUS – Deep Down Below is an unforgiving underwater first-person survival game set in a dystopian world. Find your sunken research to save humanity from an eternal life on the open sea in a continuous fight for survival.

apps.name: Sort of Cheesy: Tidy up the Cheese Cave
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game where you play as a rat with a nose for cheese. Sniff out, stack, and shelve over 300 types of cheese and milk. Complete sets to earn wedges, unlock cheesy powers like the Cheese’nado, and turn delicious chaos into satisfying order.

apps.name: Soul Gathering
apps.short_description: Every card is both your sword and your shield—but each use wears it down until it crumbles to nothing. Seven classes, a deck that decays, and enemies hungry for souls. Reach the heart of a collapsing world with whatever cards you have left. A roguelike deck-building card battler.

apps.name: Supermaneuver
apps.short_description: Retro flightcade action; dogfight in the past's future with next generation aircraft over a war-torn country as a privateer combat pilot. Choose a path, fight a war, and immerse yourself in the world of 20XX.

apps.name: SYSTEM_REBOOT
apps.short_description: You are the cursor. Swarms of corrupted processes want you deleted. A bullet-heaven roguelite where upgrades read like code, your Twitch chat votes on your build and a hidden room leads where no bullet heaven goes. Then the machine itself wakes up. Survive the swarm. Break the system.

apps.name: The Duke is Dead
apps.short_description: Duke Damian has been murdered! Collect clues, solve puzzles, and deduce the killer. Follow a growing trail of crimes and unravel the conspiracy tying them all together.

apps.name: The Fifth Bell: Frequency of Secrets
apps.short_description: The Fifth Bell is a 2D point-and-click mystery adventure set in 1990s Europe. Follow a trail of old cassettes, quiet witnesses and forgotten records, and find out why someone never wanted the fifth bell to ring.

apps.name: The Restoration Studio: Masterpiece Nonograms
apps.short_description: The Restoration Studio is a puzzle game where you restore darkened masterpieces by solving nonogram pieces. Mona Lisa, The Starry Night, Kim Hongdo’s Ssireum (Korean Wrestling), Hokusai’s The Great Wave off Kanagawa and more: 112 paintings from East and West in 2,597 puzzles, from 10×10 to 20×20.

apps.name: The Seventh Day at the Tsubaki House - Whoever You Accuse Is Guilty
apps.short_description: A Japanese mystery adventure where any of the four could be the killer. Holding the dead man's will, you stay in his estate until the seventh-day memorial. Question the household across 13 locations, but you get only ten moves. Motive, opportunity and proof decide what your accusation is worth.

apps.name: Toilet Exploration
apps.short_description: Toilet Rush is an online multiplayer party game where you explore a school with friends in search of toilets. Work together to find them—but there aren't enough for everyone! Race, shove, and betray your friends to grab a toilet before your poop meter hits 100%.

apps.name: Turnabout Tactics
apps.short_description: A chess puzzle game where you play both sides, no opponent, no checkmate. Each level sets its own objectives. Some pieces explode when captured, others freeze or shield the squares around them, and some move right through other pieces. Rewind freely until every objective is met at once.

apps.name: Tuxedo
apps.short_description: Hack and slash your way down this lengthy hallway. Monsters won't stop showing up, and you JUST WANT TO TAKE A SHIT.

apps.name: UNDIVIDED
apps.short_description: UNDIVIDED is a dark fantasy romance visual novel where your choices matter. As a corrupt sickness spreads across the land, your own life takes on new meaning. Travel with three powerful allies, decide who deserves your trust or your heart, and choose what you will risk to save a dying world.

apps.name: VALE
apps.short_description: Fight your way to dominion over the universe in this Shoot Em Up game based on the book! On the planet Vale, known for its extreme cold and endless snowfields, the story follows young Talen Esko and his sister Salla, whose family, the Esko clan, is transferred to govern this icy world.

apps.name: Vampire Suplex
apps.short_description: Punches won't finish them. Kicks won't either. SUPLEX will! Vampire SUPLEX is an absurd parody of classic 2D fighters. Survive the onslaught, seize your opening, and bring those arrogant bloodsuckers crashing down. One decisive SUPLEX. One spectacular finish.

apps.name: Veil of the Soulstones
apps.short_description: Brave the Veil of the Soulstones alone or with your friends in this brutal, real-time auto battler adventure. Loot weapons and armor from every foe to build your strength, and through powerful synergies, slay the creatures that lurk unseen in the shadows.

apps.name: Vibe Punch
apps.short_description: A VR rhythm boxing game where you punch to the beat, deflect incoming bullets and take on giant bosses. Fast-paced rhythm combat across 40 licensed tracks, with Standard and Boss modes - become the fighter who controls the rhythm.

apps.name: Vigilantes of Torque
apps.short_description: Build a life in the skies in Vigilantes of Torque, an online open-world aviation sandbox. Fly missions, own and maintain aircraft, grow your business, join factions, build airports, and cooperate or compete with other pilots across a roughly 66,805 sq mi map.

apps.name: VIZZA
apps.short_description: VIZZA turns simulations into living scenes. poke a pattern, tune its behavior and colors, record a favorite moment, or keep it moving as your wallpaper.

apps.name: Voxenvale
apps.short_description: Voxenvale is a cozy blocky online realm builder where players jump, build, trade, chat, make friends, and visit each other's cubic worlds.

apps.name: Voxotron
apps.short_description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

apps.name: WaxHeart
apps.short_description: An atmospheric puzzle-adventure platformer where a wax child with a lantern for a heart journeys through a ruined world in search of their lost memory.

apps.name: Well, Fishing
apps.short_description: Descend into magical wells filled with a thriving ecosystem of fish! Catch fish and fill out your journal, forage for bait and materials to upgrade your fishing rod. Explore wells with different biomes and fish. Help out the island folks and they might even help you catch rarer unique fish.

apps.name: What a Wish
apps.short_description: Pop bubbles, find people's wishes, and decide which ones to grant. From silly everyday requests to surprisingly heartfelt pleas, every wish is a little glimpse into someone's life. Earn Faith Points, upgrade your abilities, and unlock new ways to play in this relaxing incremental game.

apps.name: Will It Break?
apps.short_description: Pack a bottle, yeet it down the stairs, and posterize the outtake. A clean delivery pays but a spectacular disaster might pay better. Build a channel from just you and your mom and besties built on physics chaos, one staircase at a time.

apps.name: Witch Bitch
apps.short_description: Witch Bitch is a fantasy corruption RPG set in a filthy medieval world. Play as a young woman and explore the city: taverns, the brothel, the market and back alleys where the unexpected always finds you. Shed your shame, dress to provoke and raise Depravity - the world reacts to all of it.

apps.name: WW.Heaven
apps.short_description: Only the perfect go to heaven. WW.Heaven is a short first-person collectathon where you set out on a quest to fulfill your sister’s dying wish.

apps.name: アベマリロケット - Captain Patchwork -
apps.short_description: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.

apps.name: マジカルラプチャー
apps.short_description: A 2D fighting game featuring magical girls with comical moves! Unleash magic on your opponents using simple controls—no complex command inputs required. Manage your magic gauge as you battle, employing unique tactics to outplay your rivals!

apps.name: 冰心侠录：她们的掌门
apps.short_description: 一款武侠养成与卡牌策略游戏。扮演冰心派唯一的男弟子，修炼武学，与师姐妹并肩迎敌，从小师弟成长为独当一面的掌门。

apps.name: 战网魔：谁把天才变了恶魔
apps.short_description: This is a Chinese local-themed role-playing game. Plot is its core driver. It uses a male-female dual-protagonist narrative to deeply tell a story set in the new millennium, about online games and overcoming gaming addiction.

apps.name: 水泊梁山
apps.short_description: "WATER MARGIN HEROES " is a 3D strategy simulation game that combines real-time strategy (RTS), base building, survival management, and hero development. As chaos looms and heroes rise, players will lead the Liangshan heroes from a desolate land, starting from scratch.

apps.name: 生存物语
apps.short_description: SurvivalMission: A survival adventure that fuses real-time tactical stealth, base building, and squad recruitment. Battle rogue AI in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, gather your team, and rebuild civilization from the ashes.

apps.name: Active Matter - Original Game Soundtrack, Vol.1
apps.short_description: The Active Matter soundtrack was developed as a collaboration between independent composers, guest artists, and licensed tracks, and currently comprises over one hundred compositions from several dozen artists.

apps.name: Ale & Tale Tavern Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Songs and Music from the Game Ale & Tale Tavern

apps.name: No Vacation for an Executioner Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
No vacation for an executioner - Original sound track
BGM Music composed by Hava

apps.name: Owlboy - Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The Official 'Owlboy' Soundtrack, composed by Jonathan Geer.
